newsitem.title: USA: Clinton says hopes to comment on budget soon.
newsitem.headline: Clinton says hopes to comment on budget soon.

text.p: President Bill Clinton said on Friday that he hoped to be able to comment soon on the state of talks to balance the federal budget by 2002.

"I hope we'll be able to tell you something one way or the other before too long," Clinton said as he walked from the White House to a helicopter to fly to Baltimore, where he will attend a retreat with Senate Democrats.
Asked if there was a deal yet in the talks between the White House and congressional Republicans to balance the budget, Clinton replied: "Working on it."
